description: Replaces Dependabot. The package has no dependencies, so this covers GitHub Actions. Renovate merges its own patch, minor, pin and digest PRs once CI is green and the release is 3 days old; majors, and actions no PR check runs, wait for a person (INTE-4164).

packageRules.description: Automerge patch, minor, pin and digest updates once CI passes and the release has aged
These actions only run on main or on release, so no PR check exercises them. Never automerge
upload-artifact and download-artifact share a backend and must move together, majors included
